meta.name: azure-messaging
meta.description: Troubleshoot and resolve issues with Azure Messaging SDKs for Event Hubs and Service Bus. Covers connection failures, authentication errors, message processing issues, and SDK configuration problems. copy.tagline: 排查并修复Azure消息服务SDK的连接与处理故障
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果在使用Azure事件中心或服务总线时遇到SDK错误需要快速定位
copy.tagline_en: Troubleshoot and fix Azure messaging SDK connection and processing issues
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you encounter SDK errors with Azure Event Hubs or Service Bus and need quick diagnosis

howto.what: 遇到 Azure 事件中心或服务总线 SDK 连接失败、认证错误、消息处理异常、锁定丢失或超时等问题时，Claude 会进行诊断并推荐修复方案，利用 MCP 工具检查资源健康和配置，并引用文档。
howto.when: 处理 Azure 事件中心/服务总线 SDK 错误时，如连接失败、AMQP 错误、锁定丢失、会话错误、重复事件、实例停止处理等。

howto.what_en: When encountering Azure Event Hubs or Service Bus SDK connection failures, authentication errors, message processing issues, lock loss or timeouts, Claude diagnoses and recommends fixes, using MCP tools to check resource health and configuration, and referencing documentation.
howto.when_en: Triggers on Azure Event Hubs/Service Bus SDK errors: connection failures, AMQP errors, lock loss, session errors, duplicate events, processor stops, etc.
